Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.modelPackage.boardFolder.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObservable
public class Board extends Object implements GameObservable
Class that represents the board of the game. Contains both the upper and the lower card lines and the offer track.
